primary_diagnosis: Diet-Induced Non-Ulcer Dyspepsia with Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS-Mixed)
clinical_reasoning: Patient presents with a 2-month history of postprandial epigastric pinching, burning, and tenesmus/incomplete evacuation triggered specifically by high-fat foods (meat) and fermentable legumes (chickpeas, peanuts). The combination of upper GI burning and lower GI incomplete evacuation fits IBS-Mixed / dyspepsia overlap. Ongoing conception efforts require non-teratogenic dietary interventions and pregnancy-safe mucosal agents.
recommended_tests: Routine Stool Examination & Occult Blood Test
Stool Routine and Microscopy (for mucus, ova, and cysts)
Serum Beta-hCG (to confirm pregnancy status prior to medication)
Complete Blood Count (CBC) and Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate (ESR)
